name: shad-fx-dither
title: shad-fx: dither renderer
author: Piergiorgio Gonni <https://www.sekei.design>
description: DitherCanvas: fills its positioned parent with a pixelated canvas that draws any effect as Bayer-dithered cells.
docs: Pair it with any effect: `const fx = useFx(fire, { height: 0.6 })`, then `<DitherCanvas effect={fx} />`. Options passed to useFx update in place without restarting the simulation. The ordered-dither rendering derives from dither-kit (MIT, https://github.com/Boring-Software-Inc/dither-kit). See https://github.com/sekeidesign/shad-fx/blob/main/NOTICE.md
